en:
## New Features

- Chapters can now be split at any commit in their history. The chapter becomes three: a prefix holding the history up to that commit, the original chapter continuing from it, and the fork you actually wanted. The conversation is cut at the message that produced that commit; when a commit has no message behind it (hand-written `git commit`, an import), the nearest ancestor with one is used and the response says the cut was approximate
- Rebase and cherry-pick now work with uncommitted changes in the workspace. Your work is set aside in the snapshot DAG, git gets the clean tree it requires, and the changes are merged back afterwards. If the snapshot does not cover everything git reports as dirty, the operation is refused rather than risking the only other copy
- Single-use registration codes let you invite specific people while public signup stays closed. Codes can be bound to a username, carry an expiry, and are stored only as a hash — the plaintext appears once, in the response that creates it. Admins can also create accounts directly
- A setup assistant can be spawned to help diagnose missing dependencies, with the authorization level chosen explicitly in a dialog rather than assumed
- New execution log (admin): a global time-ordered view of every tool call across all narrators, with credentials redacted from payload details
- Usage statistics gained donut and stacked bar charts across Provider/Model/Kind, multi-metric line comparison, date presets, CSV export, sortable columns, and optional model-family clustering
- Built-in gateway credentials are now paginated per tier with batch delete and a \"remove errored/suspended\" action, matching what Codex already had. The unhealthy set deliberately excludes manually disabled, quota-exhausted and temporarily throttled credentials
- Themes can ship their own WOFF2 fonts. The host owns every CSS-visible detail — it generates the family name, emits the `@font-face` rule and resolves a same-origin URL — so a plugin cannot reach a remote asset or fingerprint a locally installed font
- The git changes panel now groups files into folders with collapsible rows, folder-level staging, per-folder change counts, and folder state that survives a refresh within the session
- Git diffs now render through the same viewer the narrator uses: syntax highlighting, real line numbers from the patch, word-level marks, and hunk separators. Large diffs load in 500-line steps instead of being cut off
- The browser preview can be enlarged and navigated from an address bar

## Improvements

- Injected content now travels one path instead of two. What the model receives is unchanged byte-for-byte, but the separate side-car table, its seven hand-written flush state machines and its rendering layer are gone; delivery is now one entry point with orthogonal `role` and `schedule` axes
- Injections render as a bordered note per speaker rather than the heaviest skin in the list. Teammate and background-task messages are attributed to their actual producer, and a subagent's message can no longer appear before the completion that caused it
- Story-network events now reach the graph over WebSocket instead of waiting for the 60-second poll. Two high-frequency file-activity events and one carrying merge conflict filenames are deliberately excluded from the broadcast
- The graph endpoint now admits when its git data is stale instead of silently swallowing the refresh failure, reporting which feature failed and how many chapters were affected
- Retrying a request no longer discards tool work that already happened. Previously a tool that had fully formed but whose stream broke would be replayed in place, sending an identical request forever until the budget ran out
- Compaction now times out on lack of progress rather than total elapsed time, so a large multi-chunk compaction is no longer killed for being legitimately slow, and a timeout is reported as a failure instead of vanishing silently
- `sessionStorage` no longer grows without bound: writes go through one gate with entry caps, a byte budget, LRU eviction and one retry after a quota cliff
- The plan-approval turn injected by plan reflection is no longer drawn as if you approved it yourself
- Removed the `frozen` chapter status. It had no write path and every operation refused it, so entering it meant never forking, waking, merging or reviewing again. `merged` already carries that meaning and has `unmerge` as an exit
- Removed three features that had complete tables, services, routes and components but no consumers: terminal tabs, dependency edges, and a runtime capability-negotiation layer whose 43 getters were all constants. `/api/chapter-edges` is consequently read-only
- Deleted the PIXI message renderer; the virtual list has been the only rendering path for a while
- Knowledge base: collection owners can manage and delete their own collections, `reject` is now distinct from `request_changes`, authors can withdraw a returned submission, and a new audit table records who granted which access to whom — deliberately without entry titles or bodies, so the audit log cannot itself become a read channel

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed two Anthropic errors that permanently wedged a session: an unsigned thinking block left in history, and a `sys` row landing where the API requires a user turn before it. Request bodies are now derived per model from the observed `claude-cli` contract instead of a fixed field set
- Fixed Codex native-search citation markers leaking into message text, the clipboard and model history, where the model would read its own previous output and keep reproducing them. Sources the model already linked inline are no longer numbered a second time
- Fixed a built-in gateway account suspension arriving inside a 200 response body never marking the credential, so every retry hit the same suspended account and eventually surfaced raw upstream JSON
- Fixed several paths that could silently lose your work: dormant archive directories (including plaintext secrets) surviving chapter and project deletion with no cleaner; a stale force-add memo keeping later edits to tracked-but-ignored files out of snapshots so a revert read as "nothing changed"; parked-work coordinates being discarded by a concurrent rebase, kept only in memory, or cleared after a failed restore that still reported success
- Fixed two worktree locks that did not know about each other, which meant a merge and an ordinary commit could interleave on the same index — exactly the corruption each lock existed to prevent
- Fixed the file status badge joining porcelain's two independent columns into one key, which dropped `AM`/`MM`/`AD`/`RM` into a grey fallback and showed brand-new files as a raw `??`. Conflicts now read as `U` in their own colour
- Fixed word-level diff rows losing syntax colour entirely, and a block comment opened by a removed line bleeding its highlight into untouched context lines
- Fixed the expansion state of collapsed trace rows being addressed by row index, so a model writing one more heading would collapse the card you had opened and open its neighbour instead
- Fixed Codex browser authorization being unusable when NarraFork runs on a different host than the browser: the callback URL can now be pasted manually, and pending state survives a refresh
- Fixed `ExitPlanMode` advertising a parameter that granted nothing as its only required one while the field carrying the actual plan stayed optional, which had models inventing permission declarations. Plan source is now declared explicitly and validated rather than guessed
- Fixed a demotion clearing only the cache without revoking sessions, so a just-demoted user's token kept passing `requireAdmin` until it expired naturally
- Fixed the password length cap not matching bcrypt's real 72-byte limit, which made two passwords differing only past that point the same credential
- Fixed a custom User-Agent being dropped when the override used different header capitalization, which left both keys in place and let `fetch` join them into a malformed value
- Fixed untracked directories collapsing to a single entry in the changes panel, and discarding one file deleting its siblings in the same directory
- Fixed `netsh` running without a timeout on the startup path, where a hung firewall service would wedge server startup indefinitely
- Fixed an exception mid-drain permanently losing the injections queued behind it — a teammate message or a background result that was neither in the queue nor delivered
zh-CN:
## 新功能

- 章节现在可以在历史中的任意 commit 处拆分。一个章节拆成三个：持有该 commit 之前历史的前序章节、从该 commit 继续的原章节，以及你真正想要的那个分叉。对话按产生该 commit 的消息切分；commit 背后没有消息时（手写 `git commit`、导入），退化为最近的祖先 commit，并在响应里如实说明切点是近似的
- 工作区有未提交改动时也能 rebase 和 cherry-pick。你的改动被寄存进快照 DAG，git 拿到它要求的干净工作区，事后再合并回来。如果快照没有覆盖 git 报告的全部改动，操作直接拒绝，而不是拿唯一的另一份副本去赌
- 新增单次使用的注册码，让你在公开注册关闭时仍能定向放人进来。注册码可绑定用户名、带过期时间，且只存哈希——明文只在创建响应里出现一次。管理员也可以直接建号
- 依赖缺失时可派生一个安装助手叙述者帮你排查，授权级别在弹窗里显式选择而非默认给足
- 新增执行日志（管理员）：跨全部叙述者的工具调用时间序视图，payload 详情做凭证脱敏
- 用量统计新增环形分布图与堆叠柱状图（按 Provider/Model/Kind），折线图支持多指标对比，新增日期快捷预设、CSV 导出、列头排序与可选的模型聚类
- 内置网关凭据按层级分页，补齐批量删除和「删除错误/封禁」，与 Codex 的能力对齐。不健康范围刻意排除手动禁用、配额耗尽和临时限流的凭据
- 主题可以自带 WOFF2 字体。所有 CSS 可见细节由宿主掌握——字体族名由宿主生成、`@font-face` 规则由宿主发出、来源解析为同源 URL——因此插件既无法引用远程资源，也无法探测你本地装了什么字体
- Git 变更面板按文件夹分组，支持折叠、文件夹级暂存、聚合改动计数，且展开状态在本次会话内刷新不丢
- Git 差异改用叙述者侧的同一个渲染器：语法高亮、来自 patch 的真实行号、词级标记与 hunk 分隔。大差异按 500 行下拉追加，不再被直接截断
- 浏览器预览支持放大与地址栏跳转

## 改进

- 注入内容从两条投递路径收敛为一条。模型收到的字节完全不变，但独立的 side-car 表、七份手写 flush 状态机和整层渲染代码都已移除；投递现在只有一个入口，`role`（是什么）与 `schedule`（应该发生什么）拆成正交两轴
- 注入改为每说话人一个带框注记，不再是「全列表最重的皮肤裹着最不重要的内容」。队友消息与后台任务结果按真实生产者归属，子代理的消息也不会再排在造成它的那次完成之前
- 故事网络事件现在真正经 WebSocket 到达图，不必等 60 秒兜底轮询。两个每几秒一次的文件活动事件和一个携带合并冲突文件名的事件被刻意排除在广播之外
- 图端点现在会如实承认 git 数据是旧的，而不是把刷新失败整个吞掉；按功能上报失败并带上受影响的章节规模
- 重试不再丢弃已经完成的工具进展。此前「工具已成型但流断掉」会原地重放，发出完全相同的请求字节，历史一直增长而请求从不改变，直到预算耗尽
- 压缩改为按「无进度」判定超时而非总时长，因此大上下文的多分块压缩不会再因为本来就该慢而被误杀；超时也会如实报告为失败，而不是让压缩凭空消失
- `sessionStorage` 不再无界增长：写入统一走一个入口，带条目上限、字节预算、LRU 淘汰和配额悬崖后的一次重试
- 计划反思自动批准计划时注入的那个回合，不再被画成「你批准了自己没看过的计划」
- 移除 frozen 章节状态。它没有任何写入路径，且所有操作都拒绝它——一旦进入就再也无法分叉、唤醒、合并或评审。`merged` 本就是这个语义，且有 `unmerge` 作为出口
- 移除三处有完整表/服务/路由/组件但零消费者的功能：终端标签、dependency 边，以及一个 43 个 getter 全是常量的运行时能力协商层。`/api/chapter-edges` 因此变为只读
- 删除 PIXI 消息渲染器，虚拟列表早已是唯一渲染路径
- 知识库：集合 owner 可管理和删除自己的集合；`reject`（终态拒绝）与 `request_changes`（邀请重投）区分开；作者可以撤回被退回的提交；新增审计表记录谁把什么权限给了谁——刻意不存条目标题与正文，否则审计日志本身会成为越权读取通道

## 修复

- 修复两类会永久卡死会话的 Anthropic 400：历史里留下的无签名思考块，以及 `sys` 行落在 API 要求前置 user 轮的位置。请求体现在按模型逐项派生，依据是实测的 `claude-cli` 契约，而非一份固定字段集
- 修复 Codex 原生搜索的引用标记泄漏进消息正文、剪贴板和模型历史——模型读到自己上轮输出里的标记会认为那属于自身格式并继续复现。模型已经内联链接过的来源不再被重复编号
- 修复内置网关封号作为 HTTP 200 响应体里的异常帧到达时凭据不被标记，导致每次重试都撞同一个封号账号，最终把上游原文 JSON 抛给用户
- 修复一批会静默丢用户工作的路径：dormant 归档目录（含明文密钥）在章节/项目删除后永久残留且无人清理；快照的 force-add memo 不失效，导致 tracked-but-ignored 文件的后续编辑不进快照，回退读作「什么都没变」；寄存坐标被并发 rebase 丢弃、只存在内存、或在恢复失败后被清除却仍返回成功
- 修复两把互不相识的 worktree 锁：一次 merge 与一个普通 commit 会在同一个 index 上交错执行，正是这两把锁各自要防的那类损坏
- 修复文件状态徽章把 porcelain 的两个独立列拼成一个键，使 `AM`/`MM`/`AD`/`RM` 连同颜色一起落进灰色兜底，全新未暂存文件显示为原始的 `??`。冲突现在统一显示为 `U` 并有独立颜色
- 修复词级改动行整行丢语法色，以及删除行开启的块注释把高亮串味到一字未改的上下文行
- 修复折叠 trace 行的展开状态按行序号寻址：模型多写一个标题就会把你点开的卡片折起、邻行代其打开
- 修复 NarraFork 与浏览器不在同一台机器时 Codex 授权无法完成：回调 URL 现在可以手动粘贴，pending 状态刷新页面也不丢
- 修复 `ExitPlanMode` 把一个不授予任何权限的参数广告成唯一必填项，而真正承载计划的字段仍是可选，导致模型凭空编造权限声明。计划来源现在显式声明并被校验，不再靠猜
- 修复降权只清缓存不吊销会话，导致刚被降权的用户手上的令牌继续通过 `requireAdmin`，直到自然过期
- 修复密码长度上限与 bcrypt 真实的 72 字节不符，使仅在该长度之后不同的两个密码成为同一凭证
- 修复自定义 User-Agent 因覆盖时大小写不同而失效：两个键同时留下，被 `fetch` 逗号拼接成畸形值
- 修复变更面板把未跟踪目录折成单个条目，以及丢弃单个文件时误删同目录的兄弟文件
- 修复启动路径上的 `netsh` 调用没有超时，防火墙服务卡死会让服务器永久挂起启动
- 修复注入投递过程中的异常会永久丢失排在它后面的注入——一条队友消息或后台结果既不在队列里，也没有被处理
